title: Custom Regex Matching (+)
prompt:
This is a variant of regular expression matching with support for three operators (note: this is NOT the standard LeetCode problem — there is an extra operator, so a memorized textbook solution will not directly work):

- '.' matches any single character.
- '*' matches zero or more of the preceding element.
- '+' matches one or more of the preceding element (this one is non-standard — get its boundary conditions right).

Given an input string s and a pattern p built from literal characters plus these operators, return True if the pattern matches the entire string s (not a partial match), False otherwise.
function_signature: def is_match(s: str, p: str) -> bool:
